name: Javi López, Borja Giménez Larraz - § 45 - Am 30
title: INTERIM REPORT in view of the consent procedure on the Political, Economic and Cooperation Strategic Partnership Agreement between the EU and Mexico
part_text: 45. Regrets the fact that the Agreement contains robust provisions on investment protection designed to protect investors; notes the lack of evidence that investment protection provisions help attract foreign direct investment; expresses concern that the Investment Court System continues to grant foreign investors privileged access to a parallel dispute settlement system that is unavailable to workers, communities or affected citizens; warns that this may allow investors to challenge legitimate public policy measures, creating regulatory chill and undermining state sovereignty and democratic decision-making; notes the inconsistency with the EU’s withdrawal from the Energy Charter Treaty because of similar concerns over investor claims against public-interest regulation; calls on the Commission to review the agreement with Mexico with a view to excluding investment protection provisions, as in more recent FTA negotiations; urges the parties to ensure the consistency of investment protection provisions with environmental policies, labour rights and human rights; calls on the Commission to ensure obligations for investors and access to justice for affected communities;
